titleEn: Vancouver Renovation Permit Checklist: What Requires a Permit in 2026
titleZh: 溫哥華裝修許可證清單：2026 年需要許可證的項目
contentEn:
Most Vancouver homeowners don't find out a permit was required until the city inspection fails — by which point the work is already done and the fix is expensive. This checklist tells you before you start.

When You Absolutely Need a Permit

Structural work — anything that involves removing, moving, or cutting into a load-bearing wall, beam, or foundation always requires a structural permit in Vancouver. This also covers adding new windows or exterior doors, which change the building envelope. A registered structural engineer must stamp the drawings before you submit.

Electrical and plumbing upgrades — a new 200-amp electrical service, a new gas line, or anything that requires a utility connection notification needs a permit. These are separate from your building permit, and both can run concurrently — but both are required.

Basement suites — creating a new secondary suite in Vancouver requires both a building permit and a plumbing permit, plus a separate suite registration application to the City of Vancouver. Budget 8–12 weeks for the full approval cycle, and note that your property must meet zoning and parking requirements before the City will approve the suite.

Any addition that changes floor area — adding a laneway house, extending a main-floor room, or building a new deck that is more than 60 cm (2 feet) above grade requires a building permit. Decks under 60 cm above grade and under 10 m² may be exempt, but Vancouver's bylaw exemptions are specific — confirm before you start.

When You Likely Don't Need a Permit

Minor cosmetic work — painting, replacing flooring, installing shelving — never needs a permit. Replacing windows in existing openings with same-size windows also generally doesn't, provided you use a licensed contractor who pulls any necessary trade permits.

Tip: Even when a permit isn't required from the City, your Strata council (if you own a condo or townhouse) may have its own approval requirements. Check your council minutes before demo day.

The Vancouver Permit Process Step by Step

  1. Pre-application consultation (recommended for complex jobs) — book a free 20-minute consultation at Vancouver's Permit Centre. Bring your floor plans and scope of work. They will tell you exactly which permits you need before you submit anything.
  2. Submit through the CoV Permits portal — most residential permits are filed at vanpermits.vancouver.ca. You will need scaled drawings, a site plan showing lot boundaries, and sometimes a geotechnical report.
  3. Wait for initial review — simple permits (bathroom replacement, minor electrical) are typically reviewed in 5–10 business days. Structural work and suite creation can take 4–8 weeks for initial review.
  4. Schedule inspections — once work begins, you must book inspections at each major stage: rough-in (before drywall), insulation, and final. Failed inspections require re-booking and sometimes opening finished walls.

Common Reasons Vancouver Permits Get Rejected

  • Drawings not to scale — the City does not guess. Unreadable or non-scaled drawings are automatically rejected. Use architectural scale rulers and proper conventions.
  • Missing structural engineer letter — removing any wall or cutting a notch in a beam requires a stamped letter from a registered structural engineer in British Columbia.
  • Incomplete existing conditions — if you have prior unpermitted work, you must proactively disclose it and may need to legalize it before new permits will be approved.
  • Setback violations — additions that encroach on required side-yard setbacks are the most common reason laneway house permits are rejected. A surveyor confirms setbacks before design begins.

2026 Vancouver Permit Fee Estimates

Permit TypeEstimated Fee (CAD)
Building permit — small (e.g. bathroom renovation)$200–$600
Building permit — large (e.g. suite creation)$2,000–$8,000+
Electrical permit$100–$300
Plumbing permit$100–$250
Plumbing permit — suite creation$500–$1,200
Demolition permit$150–$400
Laneway house (all fees)$6,000–$15,000

Fees are estimates; actual fees are calculated on the declared construction value. Confirm current fees at vancouver.ca/permits.

What is the first step to get a renovation permit in Vancouver?

The first step is to contact the City of Vancouver Permit Centre for a free 20-minute pre-application consultation, or to file your application through the CoV Permits portal at vanpermits.vancouver.ca. Bring scaled drawings and a written scope of work. The City will tell you which permits are required before you formally submit.

How long does a Vancouver building permit take to approve?

Simple permits such as a bathroom replacement or minor electrical work are typically reviewed in 5–10 business days. Structural permits and new secondary suite applications take longer — initial review can be 4–8 weeks, and the full process including inspections may take 8–12 weeks or more for basement suite conversions.

Does a kitchen renovation in Vancouver need a permit?

A cosmetic kitchen renovation — painting, replacing cabinet fronts, new flooring — does not need a permit. However, if your kitchen renovation involves moving plumbing lines, adding or removing walls, or changing the electrical service, separate building, plumbing, and/or electrical permits are required.

What happens if I renovate without a permit in Vancouver?

If you complete work that required a permit without obtaining one, the City of Vancouver can issue a stop-work order, require you to expose finished work for inspection, levy fines, and require you to legalize the work through a retroactive permit process that often costs significantly more than obtaining the permit upfront.
contentZh:
大多數溫哥華業主都是在市府驗收不合格後，才發現需要許可證——那時工程已經做完，修改代價昂貴。這份清單讓您在動工前就心知肚明。

哪些情況絕對需要許可證

結構工程 — 任何涉及拆除、挪動或切割承重牆、梁或地基的工程，都需要結構許可證。在外牆開新窗戶或新門口（即改變建築圍護結構）也包含在內。提交前，必須由卑詩省註冊結構工程師加蓋印章。

水電升級 — 新增 200 安培供電、新瓦斯管線，或任何需要公共事業通知的工程，都需要許可證。這與建築許可證是分開的，兩者可以同時申請，但兩者均屬必要。

地下室套房 — 在溫哥華創建新的第二套間，需要建築許可證和水管許可證，還需要向溫哥華市政府遞交套房登記申請。整個審批周期預計需要 8 至 12 週，請注意您的房產必須符合分區規劃和停車位要求，市政府才會批准套房申請。

任何改變建築面積的加建 — 興建後巷屋、擴建主層房間，或建造離地面超過 60 公分（2 呎）的新露台，都需要建築許可證。高度低於 60 公分、面積小於 10 平方公尺的露台可能可豁免，但溫哥華的附例豁免條件有明確規定，動工前請先向市政府確認。

哪些情況可能不需要許可證

輕微的美容裝修工程——油漆、更換地板、安裝架子——不需要許可證。在現有洞口更換尺寸相同的窗戶通常也不需要，但需使用有執照的承包商，並由其領取任何必要的行業許可證。

提示：即使不需要市府許可證，如果您的單位隵於共管柏文或城市屋，管委會可能有自己的審批要求。拆除工程前請先查閱您的委員會會議記錄。

溫哥華許可證流程步驟

  1. 預申請諮詢（複雜工程建議使用）— 通過溫哥華市政府許可中心預約 20 分鐘免費諮詢。攜帶您的平面圖和工程範圍說明。他們會在您提交前告訴您需要哪些許可證。
  2. 通過 CoV Permits 門戶提交 — 大多數住宅許可證通過 vanpermits.vancouver.ca 辦理。您需要比例繪圖、顯示地塊邊界的場地平面圖，有時還需要地質技術報告。
  3. 等待初審 — 簡單許可證（浴室更換、小型電氣）通常在 5 至 10 個工作天內審查。結構工程和套房創建的初審可能需要 4 至 8 週。
  4. 現場檢查 — 工程開工後，您需要在每個主要階段預約檢查：粗裝修（封牆前）、隔熱層和最終驗收。檢查不合格需要重新預約，有時還需要拆開牆面。

許可證常見被駁回原因

  • 平面圖未按比例繪製 — 市政府不會猜測；無法辨識或未按比例的繪圖會被自動駁回。請使用建築比例尺和正確的圖示規範。
  • 缺少結構工程師信函 — 拆除任何牆體或在梁上開槽，都需要卑詩省註冊結構工程師的加蓋印章信函。
  • 現況圖紙不完整 — 如果您以前有未經許可的工程，需要主動披露並可能需要先將其正規化，才能獲批新許可證。
  • 後退距離違規 — 加建工程侵佔法定側院後退距離，是後巷屋許可證被拒的最常見原因。設計前應由測量師確認後退距離。

2026 年溫哥華許可證費用概算

許可證類型概算費用（加元）
建築許可證（小型——如浴室裝修）$200–$600
建築許可證（大型——套房創建）$2,000–$8,000+
電氣許可證$100–$300
水管許可證$100–$250
水管許可證（套房創建）$500–$1,200
拆除許可證$150–$400
後巷屋（全部費用）$6,000–$15,000

費用為概算，實際費用根據施工鑒定價值計算。請通過 vancouver.ca/permits 向溫哥華市政府確認最新收費標準。

在溫哥華申請裝修許可證的第一步是什麼？

第一步是聯繫溫哥華市政府許可中心，預約免費的 20 分鐘預申請諮詢，或通過 CoV Permits 門戶（vanpermits.vancouver.ca）提交申請。請攜帶比例繪圖和書面工程範圍說明。市政府工作人員將在您正式提交前告訴您需要哪些許可證。

溫哥華建築許可證需要多長時間才能獲批？

簡單許可證（如浴室更換或小型電氣工程）的初審通常在 5 至 10 個工作天內完成。結構許可證和新建第二套間的初審可能需要 4 至 8 週，整個流程（包括驗收）可能需要 8 至 12 週或更長。

在溫哥華廚房裝修需要許可證嗎？

美容性質的廚房裝修——油漆、更換櫃門、新地板——不需要許可證。但是，如果您的廚房裝修涉及移動水管線、拆除或新增牆體、或更改供電服務，則需要單獨的建築、管道和/或電氣許可證。

在溫哥華無許可證裝修會有什麼後果？

如果您在未取得許可證的情況下完成了需要許可證的工程，溫哥華市政府可發出停工令、要求您拆除已完成工程以進行驗收、處以罰款，並要求您通過補辦許可證程序將工程正規化——所需費用通常遠高於一開始就申請許可證。
